description:
Get a specific lead by ID from Holded CRM.

Args:
  - lead_id (string): The lead ID to retrieve (required)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Lead details including contact, potential, stage, and custom fields.

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_crm_get_lead
title: Get Holded Lead
